fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Ideogram API key (developer.ideogram.ai > API dashboard, after adding a payment method and credits), sent as the Api-Key header.

adapter.terms: Image URLs are ephemeral (signed, expiring); download and re-host results.

me.note: GET /models?scope=owned: the key's own custom models; used as a credential check (there is no account endpoint).

generate_image.note: POST /generate {image_request: {prompt, negative_prompt, aspect_ratio, model, seed, resolution}} (the JSON generate endpoint, listed under Legacy Endpoints) -> {data: [{url, seed, resolution, is_image_safe}]}, synchronous. aspect_ratio uses Ideogram enums (ASPECT_16_9, ASPECT_1_1 …), model V_2, V_2_TURBO, V_2A, V_3 … (default V_2); size is a resolution enum such as RESOLUTION_1024_1024 and cannot be combined with aspect_ratio. The Ideogram 3.0/4.0 endpoints take multipart/form-data and are not mapped.

get_job.note: GET /v1/generations/{generation_id}: status pending|completed|failed of an asynchronous generation (the Ideogram 4.0 async endpoints return the generation_id); once completed data[] carries the image/video URLs (all in raw.data).

list_items.note: GET /models: custom models owned by or shared with the key (items are models; custom_model_uri is what generation takes). Not paginated.

not_offered.generate_video: The only video endpoint (POST /v1/product-360-video, 'Create a looping 360-degree product video') takes a multipart/form-data product image upload; multipart request bodies are not supported by the runtime.
not_offered.create_item: Datasets and models are created with multipart asset uploads / training requests (https://developer.ideogram.ai/api-reference/custom-model-training/upload-dataset-assets), not a JSON item body the vocabulary can express.
not_offered.update_item: No update endpoint for models or datasets is documented.
not_offered.delete_item: No delete endpoint for models or datasets is documented.

evidence: host api.ideogram.ai: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://api.ideogram.ai/openapi.json: 5/5 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
